features.name: Pause governor (fullscreen, battery, remote session)
features.evidence: autotest: fullscreen test window paused then resumed widgets (3/3 runs)

features.name: Live wallpapers: video, animated web pages, opt-in scene drift
features.evidence: autotest 19/19 with a real 1080p H.264 clip: dropped video imported, streamed in 206 ranges, playing after governor pause/resume; click test 33/33 selects Aurora; 47 wallpaper unit tests; cost measured per kind (scripts/measure-wallpapers.ps1)

features.name: Security Center (Windows security status, connections, listeners, startup items)
features.evidence: autotest 20/20: 3 firewall profiles, Defender On/up to date, 7 listeners, 28 connections, 15 startup items read in 1.7 s; click test 37/37; ports cross-checked against netstat; hub escaping verified with hostile data
features.missing: scheduled tasks and services, per-connection bytes, blocked-attempt log from Windows Firewall, file signature checks, Defender detections history; product-state decode UNVERIFIED

features.name: Monitor selector: detection, layout diagram, Identify, widget-to-monitor assignment, per-monitor layers, edge-case recovery
features.evidence: fake-monitor lifecycle test 13/13 (3 monitors, unplug, replug, park all, reset, undo); real two-monitor enumeration and layers verified (widgets rendered live on the case screen); hub click-then-click and drag assignment verified; 80 core tests incl. 14 for reconcile
features.missing: right-click Move to monitor; dock/undock, port swap, identical monitors, mixed DPI, virtual desktops NOT TESTED (copies of a widget on several monitors: built in v0.10.1, lifecycle test 15/15)

features.name: Wallpaper library: bundled images, folder scanning and watching, thumbnails, dedupe, fit modes, slideshow, per-monitor wallpapers
features.evidence: library end-to-end test 10/10 on the real monitors (scan, dedupe, corrupt file, watcher, compose at exact resolution, OS wallpaper set per monitor, slideshow, exact Revert); 10,003-picture benchmark; click test 50/50; hub memory at 10,014 pictures measured (+46 MB open, peak about 540 MB under continuous fast scrolling)
features.missing: directory-change notifications (polling every 5 s), thumbnails of animated wallpapers, GPU load, per-monitor slideshow timing under battery saver untested

features.name: Moods (automatic profile switching) and setup cards (export, review, import)
features.evidence: Moods and cards autotest 11/11 (rule applies, stands down after a manual choice, reapplies after a context change, suggestion after 3 manual choices, accept creates one rule, card export, review, apply, undo); click test 52/52; 13 new core tests
features.missing: cost of the 5 s context poll not measured; wallpapers are not part of cards; no store; Builds showcase not built

features.name: Drag-and-drop widget placement (edit overlay on the desktop, draggable hub diagram, snapping, per-monitor)
features.evidence: 2026-11-06 on this PC (two real 1920x1080 monitors): scripts/dragtest.ps1 14/14 in 3 runs in a row with the real mouse (pointer over a widget reaches the overlay; outside widgets it reaches the desktop; drop saved; drag onto the other monitor saved its stable id; Done removes the overlay); fake-monitor lifecycle test 17/17 incl. hub place and a refused drop while parked; 18 core tests for snap/retarget/placed incl. mixed DPI and reconcile round trip; click test 55/55 with the new hub
features.missing: dragging in the hub diagram with a real pointer NOT TESTED (its place command is tested); keyboard nudge NOT TESTED; touch/pen NOT TESTED; mixed DPI and the 1280x400 case screen only covered by unit tests (the second monitor on this PC is now 1920x1080); overlay is uniformly translucent, not per-pixel; right-click Move to monitor still not built

features.name: Motion overlays for still wallpapers (particles, soft light, rain, gradient drift)
features.evidence: 2026-11-06: overlay autotest 14/14 (sandboxed iframe with only two numbers in its query, served 200, loaded in the live layer, yields to a live wallpaper with the reason shown, governor unloads and reloads it, amount and speed change the query and the cost, refused as a wallpaper, none in Safe mode); core tests (9 motion, 1 wallpaper kind) and a host CSP test; cost measured once per overlay on this PC (RESULTS.md)
features.missing: CPU figures are noisy single runs and the covered case did not drop to about 0 (NOT explained); GPU load NOT measured; overlay is drawn on the primary monitor only; the look of the four overlays was not reviewed by screenshot; no import of user overlays (bundled only); not tested on battery, in a real game or in a remote session

features.name: Custom skins (data-only look tokens: global and per widget, in setup cards, hub editor)
features.evidence: 2026-11-06: skins autotest 11/11 on this PC (live layer computed styles match the skin: 30 px corners, rgba(16,32,48,0.7), blur 32 px; per-widget override; bad skins and hostile cards refused; export card parses strictly and holds no CSS characters; import under a new id without overwriting; Undo; delete falls back to default); 17 skin and card tests in plinth-core; one screenshot showed Terminal (monospace), Paper card (serif, Notes) and Soft pill (clock) on the real desktop
features.missing: font, ink and accent delivery to widgets is OBSERVED once by screenshot, not asserted by a test; the hub editor was not click-tested (its commands are tested); hard-to-read warning is a WCAG ratio, not tested on people; widgets without Plinth's SDK keep their own font and accent; no per-monitor skins; skins are not in the hub's live preview of scenes
